pass_b_english: CHAPTER TEN. On the Gospel: where also on the Apostles' Creed.

The Gospel is the word of God announcing and proposing to all humans Christ the Redeemer with His merits to be apprehended, and freely promising to those who apprehend Him by living faith remission of sins, righteousness, and eternal salvation for His sake.

Gospel properly means a good or glad message. In theology it notes the good news of the Savior born for us (Luke 2:10-11) and His merits; specially the doctrine of Christ the Redeemer and free remission of sins for Him (Matt. 11:5; Rom. 1:16). Sometimes by synecdoche it means the whole New Testament teaching, which also embraces the law (Mark 1:14-15).
source_text: CAPUT DECIMUM, De Euangelio: ubi de Symbolo Apostolorum. Euangelium est verbum Dei annuncians & proponens omnibus hominibus apprehendendum Christum redemptorem cum meritis suis, & gratis promittens eum viva fide apprehendentibus propter eundem remissionem peccatorum, iustitiam & salutem aeternam. Euangelii, quod proprie significat bonum seu laetum nunciam, definitionem scite proponunt Theologi Leidenses synops. disp. 22 thesibus primis sex, & D. Lutherus. Notat in Theologia bonum nunciam de nato nobis salvatore Luc. 2:10-11 eiusque meritis; speciatim doctrinam de Christo redemptore & gratuita remissione peccatorum propter illum (Matth. 11:5; Rom. 1:16). Alias per synecdochen totam doctrinam N.T. quae etiam legem complectitur (Marc. 1:14-15).
